It is a Quake 1-inspired boomer shooter with a hint of Painkiller. So it is the best mix.

Follow us for more stupidly fun  Massacre!

Mage Arena is a game where you and your friends, or random teammates, play against another team. Your goal is to take over the base, and as you do, you clash with them in huge battles where you sling spells and do some really cool ♥♥♥♥. It gets super funny when you hear other people trying to pronounce the spells and how they react. It is a totally fun game, and I really recommend it!

Highly recommended for any fan, great combat and graphics. Fun game.
Some side quests are very lackluster (like fetching someone a towel...) - others with shootouts, are much more fun and pertinent. Diaglogue is great with certain characters, while for others are weak.
Only minor issue on gameplay is that moving through levels can be slow, even with sprinting it is somewhat limited by the design of Robocop. The boost helps but can only be used during combat sections.
New Game+ is okay but limited, I obtained all skills early on and my weapons were extremely powerful.
To the point of near insta killing bosses, it was not much of a challenge even on the hardest setting.
The only gun worth using when upgraded, is the default.
Fun game, if I had an airsoft I would shoot my 2 balls rn but still fun

This is one of my favourite games of all time. The balance between epxloration, action and story is perfect. The visuals and landscape truly creates a deep sense of the exploring the ancient Andean civilizations. My only tiny issue is that I think the skill upgrade tree feels a bit like it doesn't really make any difference.

The game definitely has the potential, but the developers must fix some design issues, for example add a map and normal way to save the game instead of checkpoints. Replaying the same area many times is simply annoying.
good game nice change from the drab that is thrown out sometimes, love the art style
Game feels like playing the trailers, the mood feels good like it fits well with the atmosphere.
This hell of a masterpiece cured my depression, fixed my love life and got it for the sweet price of too much. thanks Garfield kart!

Visually impressive apart from the character models for some reason. Story didn't catch me at all, and there are sections in the demo that feel like superfluous fetch quests. Let's hope they'll work on it some more because it does have potential.

Brilliant combat design, so focused and snappy! Been a very long time since I got my hands on so well thought through top-down action. The visuals, GUI and music flow beautifully together. For how short this game actually is, it is offering more satisfaction than other large titles I've waited for years. 

I really hope this team gets more attention. Candellum getting a bigger scope version would be a dream come true!
Great mix of simple mechanics and dynamic gameplay as the variety in settings and map design lets you replay infinitely without losing the rush of solving a hole and mechanically executing on it

i'm usually not into roguelikes, in part because i'm pretty bad at them. so it's surprising that i've had a lot of fun with this one! i could see myself sinking a handful more hours into it (and not beating it because, yeah i'm baaaad). worth it!
Stop needless updates only to add things we didn't ask for and break the things we do love about the game.

great game , i got it way back when it was in early access and ive seen this game grow into one of my favorite isometric / diablo style type of games , its an ARPG but a lot more forgiving than the souls type of games out there , would recommend to anyone that likes greek mythology, isometric arpgs
Good game, massive shame it's been delisted. Sequel deserves a PC port.

I couldn't review this previously because it just wouldn't run correctly on either of my PCs. I had hoped it'd be a good travel game on my laptop, but didn't work. However, it works great on the Steam Frame, and I've really been enjoying it. Sort of gives me Dave the Diver timed vibes, but with some pretty plot specific cop stuff.

It's everything you'd want it to be and surprisingly more.

You really feel like you're in South Park, all the absurd tropes and characters are there.  They literally make sure to check all the boxes you'd expect.

And there's a respectable combat system that is almost a precursor to the E33 system from years later.

If you like South Park you'll absolutely enjoy this game.
The first game in steam that force you using the Twitch account, all game can't using the steam login should be ban.

This is overall a very solid batman game, extremely underrated. The Joker story genuinly one of the best ive ever seen/played, your opinion might be different but for me, i loved this game. Gliding could be better though
Genuinely, 10/10 game. Recommend this game to ANYONE. You fully bond with your homies, and become one. A work or art, and very very well done.

What a ride! One of the most emotional gaming experiences I have ever had. 

I have been a fan of the franchise since day 1. Mafia 1 and 2 are one of my all time favorites, but this game has just surpassed it probably. I just finished the game and I am trying to absorb it all. 

The beautiful setting, stunning visuals, great characters, amazing story telling, creative and entertaining missions. It has it all. Don't expect GTA/Red Dead style of the game, even though there is sort of an open world map, it is still pretty much linear main story campaign with free ride mode for a sandbox type of play.

I can only recommend this game, to be honest, I can't wait for the next instalment of this franchise.
I expected more. It’s ok but too repetitive . Definitely can’t compare to blasphemous, for example.
Super mechanics with variety, 10/10 art, runs well (even though it's Unreal Engine), writing is sometimes a bit cheesy. Highly recommended.

Works great with UEVR. Amazing graphics. Fun combat system.
Was an amazing game. Story was great but could have been a little better that last chapter was to short with only being 1 mission. 100% the game in under 50 hours in only absolute mode

Good graphics, voice acting and story, but the gameplay is repetitive and there is a little bit of stuttering.

Break it up by playing an hour at a time and just enjoy the scenery and setting.

Well worth it for the price.

It sucks that a game that is as beautiful from a story, gameplay, and environment perspective could be so hideous in its business maneuvering and broken promises. Along with the classic gaming CEO line of "We're not using AI in the game itself just in the background" that basically just means they're laying off the staff who made what we like about it the second they think the technology can replicate the work (it can't and never will). Joining my friends in leaving this.

Very impressed with how good this feels to play. From the Directional Air Dash to the Parries everything feels very crisp and great to control. The animation work on enemies is genuinely outstanding as well. Attacks are very intuitive to read and don't require you to just learn patterns by memory. The very high quality on most animations does make it noticeable when something isn't quite at the same level (the death animation when you fall in a pit for example), but I think speaks more so to how well everything else is done when something sticks out by just being 'okay'.
